notes:
Replication statistics are explicitly supplied author-derived primary table values; no calculations performed here. Coded replication scores alone are not treated as authors’ narrative verdict.  Primary table target_raw_stat is unethical-versus-ethical means, not the original three-condition omnibus eta-squared test. The full linked primary report supplies the matching omnibus test; those printed F and p supersede the mismatched pairwise test in the processed table.
Completion source review (n_o): Study 1a explicitly identifies the final analytic sample as 156 after 21 exclusions from 177 completers. This is the participant sample for the three-condition self-dehumanization ANOVA.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Study 1a Results prints partial eta-squared .04 for the three-condition self-dehumanization ANOVA, with F(2, 153) = 3.50 and exact same-test p = .033. Preserve partial eta-squared as printed, without conversion to eta-squared.
